messages.subject: Re: Spatial DGMM question
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kylie,

I have the same problem. My dataset is not that large ( ~200 features, ~ 34000 pixel) and the computer has 128 GB RAM.

R version 3.6.0 (2019-04-26)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

Running under: Windows 7 x64 (build 7601) Service Pack 1
Cardinal 2.2.6
BiocParallel_1.18.0

I get exactly the same error messages as Eduardo has stated above.

dgmm <- spatialDGMM(data_peaks, r=1, k=5, method='gaussian', dist='chebyshev',
                    annealing = TRUE, init=c('gmm'), iter.max=100,
                    BPPARAM=SerialParam(stop.on.error = TRUE, threshold = "INFO",
                                        logdir = NA_character_, log = TRUE, progressbar = TRUE))

did not work for me with the following error:

calculating spatial weights...
INFO [2019-10-07 15:34:15] loading futile.logger package
  |===============================================================================================================| 100%

segmenting feature images...
INFO [2019-10-07 15:34:43] loading futile.logger package
  |                                                                                                               |   0%r = 1, k = 5, feature = 1 .
  |=                                                                                                              |   0%r = 1, k = 5, feature = 2 .
  |=                                                                                                              |   1%r = 1, k = 5, feature = 3 .
  |==                                                                                                             |   1%r = 1, k = 5, feature = 4 .
  |==                                                                                                             |   2%r = 1, k = 5, feature = 5 .
  |===                                                                                                            |   2%r = 1, k = 5, feature = 6 .
  |===                                                                                                            |   3%r = 1, k = 5, feature = 7 .
  |====                                                                                                           |   3%r = 1, k = 5, feature = 8 ERROR [2019-10-07 15:40:32] missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Error in if (error_old - error_new < tol) break :  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Would be great if you could look into this as for now I am not able to process any of my data with dgmm.

Thanks,
Melanie

messages.subject: Error when clustering (invalid blocks)
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
i have an issue with an imported bruker dataset. Everything is fine but when i try to use spatialShrunkenCentroids, or kMeans, or other clustering methods, Cardinal gives me the following error:

reducing dimension prior to k-means
projecting 12 FastMap components with gaussian spatial weights
  |                                                                                             |   0%r = 1

Error in .findSpatialBlocks(.object, groups = run(.object), nblocks = .blocks,  :  invalid blocks

What does this means? invalid blocks?

Regards

Edu
